HAMPTON & CO. KITCHENS — Cranbourne, VIC 3977

Designed, built and installed in the south-east since 2011. Fourteen years, over 900 kitchens, and
the same three cabinetmakers in the workshop the whole time. We don't use contract installers.

OUR PRICING IS BY THE LINEAL METRE

Every kitchen we build is priced the way the industry prices them — by the lineal metre of cabinetry
along the run. Measure the wall your kitchen sits against, add the island if you're having one, and
that's your lineal metre figure. A typical galley is around 4 lineal metres, an L-shape about 6, a
U-shape with an island somewhere between 8 and 11.

  Essentials range          $1,250 per lineal metre
  Classic range             $1,850 per lineal metre
  Signature range           $2,650 per lineal metre
  Architectural range       from $3,400 per lineal metre

Those figures are supply and install and they cover cabinetry, standard soft-close hardware, doors,
kickboards, fillers, scribing and the fit-off. Benchtop is separate and so is everything below.

Tall units, pantries and appliance towers are priced at 1.5 lineal metres each because of the
carcass height, and an island is charged on its own perimeter, not its length.

IF YOU'VE ALREADY BOUGHT YOUR KITCHEN

We'll install a flat-pack or a customer-supplied kitchen. Same method — $680 per lineal metre for
assembly and fit-off, or $520 if it arrives already assembled.

BENCHTOPS

  Laminate                  $420 per lineal metre
  Timber                    $680 per lineal metre
  Reconstituted stone       $980 per lineal metre
  Natural stone             POA — depends entirely on the slab

Cut-outs for a sink, a cooktop and a tap are $180 each. Waterfall ends are $650 a side.

TAKING THE OLD ONE OUT

Strip-out and disposal is charged at $340 per lineal metre of the existing kitchen. If the old
kitchen is going to a charity or you're keeping some of it, we'll adjust that down.

PREPARATION

Wall preparation, floor preparation, floor levelling and plaster repair are quoted after the site
measure. Cabinets need square walls and a level floor and we won't guess at what yours needs from a
photo.

THE EXTRAS

Island bench, walk-in pantry, appliance cabinetry, integrated bin drawers, sink and tap installation
and laundry cabinetry are all available and all priced per lineal metre at your chosen range.
Splashbacks we sub out to a glazier or a tiler and pass through at cost.

THE PROCESS

Free in-home consultation and measure. Design and 3D render. A fixed written quote before anything
is ordered. Four to six weeks in the workshop, then two to four days on site.

Minimum job is 3 lineal metres.

Based in Cranbourne, we cover 45km — the whole south-east, the peninsula and out to Pakenham.

All prices include GST.

Every kitchen carries a 7 year structural warranty on our cabinetry and a 2 year warranty on the
installation. Hardware carries its manufacturer's warranty, which on the Blum product we use is
lifetime.

— Andrew Hampton, Director
